adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `accessTokenParsed` is assigned from `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`. The implementation of `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `safeParse` is unsuccessful, and otherwise returns the successful `safeParse` result. Therefore the subsequent `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { ... }` branch is effectively unreachable/redundant at runtime (dead code), but it does not introduce broken behavior by itself.
